content:
Reading this paper which uses the theory of divergences, applied to discrete probability spaces. I see the KL divergence in mathlib, is anyone working on a (presumably more general) version?

My main interest is to use the discrete theory laid out in the paper above, but if there's a clear path to formalizing a more general result (not discrete, for example) I might be able to help!
I do have families of probability distributions and divergences and amari things, but it is not in a public state (would have to discuss)

Ah--thanks. Since posting this, I have chatted with Remy about reviving https://github.com/RemyDegenne/testing-lower-bounds. Then, pretty much right after we chatted, I had to put it on the back burner. I plan to pick this back up mid-September once I return to the project described above.
may not check here if you get back to this in September so instead just add me as a collaborator on that Github repo you just linked or similar. Cobord is the name
